title: Case II Illustration: Aircraft-Shaped Object with Surrounding Light Glow
description: Shaded illustration, viewed from above, of an object with a cigar-shaped body and straight wings, an arrow pointing up for direction of travel, and a diffuse halo around it. Callouts read "Light glow" and "Fuzzy area". The preceding text says the Case II objects were "shaped like conventional aircraft" with a red glow around each. Below the drawing, the text of Case III (Serials 2013.00, 2014.00 and 2014.01) describes two tower operators' January 20, 1951 sighting of a light over a city airport (page 79).
